query: For my 45-year-old female: among female admissions aged 40–50 with primary sepsis/septic shock, what's the hospital length-of-stay IQR?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los)) AS interquartile_range FROM icustays JOIN patients ON icustays.subject_id = patients.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age = 45 AND icustays.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND icustays.intime <= '2018-01-01' AND icustays.outtime >= '2018-12-31' AND (icustays.los > 10 AND icustays.los <= 30) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code IN ('E116', 'E117', 'E118', 'E119')) > 0;
